item.title: Top 20 Music Charts – 20 Genres Ranked (Feb 24, 2026)
item.description: Machel Montano makes a powerful Caribbean Club debut at No.2 and Bruno Mars suddenly appears at No.3 in Dance Pop with a fresh 2026 release. In Corridos, Xavi and Carin León leap straight to the summit with “La Morrita,” marking one of the most striking chart takeovers of the week.Elsewhere, Kaytranada enters Alternative R&B with “DJ Set,” Charli XCX debuts in Art Pop, and Burna Boy lands a high Nigerian Pop entry with “For Everybody.” Unexpected arrivals from ENHYPEN, Protoje, and Joyner Lucas
